breaking.change: Removed count attributes on ordinary text and the -og-count-duration, -og-count-decimals, -og-reveal and -og-spotlight CSS properties. These semantics use reflected og- tags without legacy aliases.
breaking.fix: Use <og-counter value={$score} duration="900" decimals="0">, <og-typewriter rate="20" onrevealed={done}>, and <og-spotlight target="Target" bind:open={$tour}>. Typewriter rate counts extended grapheme clusters, preserving combining marks and joined emoji. Tick timing, checkpoints and completion events remain supported.
